nodes.label: Yearly Time-Limited License
nodes.rationale: App runs one year from first install, then blocks itself and shows the vendor contact number until a renewal code is bought. Fully offline: no internet needed. A "license expiring soon" popup appears in the last 15 days.

nodes.label: Activation ID
nodes.rationale: Format A1B2C3D4-01: first part derived from the PC hardware ID, suffix is the renewal number. Shown on a screenshot-friendly screen so nothing has to be read aloud and characters cannot be misheard.

nodes.label: Renewal Code
nodes.rationale: Signed code bound to both the specific PC and the renewal number, so it only works once on one machine (replay protection). Case-insensitive, dashes optional.

nodes.label: WhatsApp Renewal Workflow
nodes.rationale: Customer pays, WhatsApps a screenshot of the expiry screen, vendor generates a code and replies; customer types it in and the license extends one year.

nodes.label: TestMode One-Minute Expiry Flag
nodes.rationale: Const in LicenseService compresses the license to one minute for testing. A build shipped with TestMode=true expires one minute after first launch; this already happened once, so it is the most important item on the shipping checklist.

nodes.label: RepairShortPeriod Self-Repair
nodes.rationale: On every load raises any expiry below install date + (renewals+1) x 1 year. Lets customers poisoned by a TestMode build back in without a renewal code, while never shortening a legitimate license nor gifting time to a genuinely expired one.

nodes.label: DPAPI Dual-Store License Record
nodes.rationale: Install date, expiry, last-run time and renewal count are JSON-serialized, DPAPI-encrypted (LocalMachine) and written to both HKCU registry and a hidden ProgramData file; on launch both are reconciled (earliest install wins, latest expiry/renewal wins) so deleting one copy cannot reset the trial.

nodes.label: Clock Rollback Detection
nodes.rationale: A monotonic last-run timestamp detects the Windows clock being set backwards and blocks with a date/time problem message.

nodes.label: RenewalSecret Signing Secret
nodes.rationale: Must match exactly between LicenseService.RenewalSecret and $Secret in the generator script and must never change after shipping. Because verification is offline the secret ships inside the exe: this stops ordinary shop users but not a determined reverse-engineer; online activation is the stronger next step.

nodes.label: Pre-Shipping License Checklist
nodes.rationale: TestMode to false, real WhatsApp number, private RenewalSecret set once and mirrored in the script, clear stored license so the build starts fresh.

nodes.label: LicenseExpiredWindow (blocking expiry screen)
nodes.rationale: Shown before the login screen once expired; displays contact number, Activation ID and a renewal code box.

nodes.label: Startup License Gate in App.xaml.cs
nodes.rationale: Runs CheckLicense() before the login window and blocks the app if expired.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture Solution Layout (Core/Data/Infrastructure/UI/Tests)
nodes.rationale: Five projects: Core (entities, interfaces, pure services), Data (EF Core 9 + SQLite, 19 migrations), Infrastructure (repositories, cloud backup, edition, license, barcode), UI (WPF MVVM), Tests (xUnit + Moq).

nodes.label: Business Logic Inside ViewModels
nodes.rationale: Totals, saving and printing live inside ViewModels (SaleViewModel 1,097 lines, PharmacySaleViewModel 1,270) with no checkout/service layer, so tax, tenders, FEFO, PSE and Rx cannot be tested or made atomic there.

nodes.label: Proposed SaleCalculator (pure, in Core)
nodes.rationale: Pure unit-tested calculator with AwayFromZero rounding at line-tax level; the PK path keeps its exact current math, locked by characterization tests written first.

nodes.label: Proposed Transactional CheckoutService
nodes.rationale: Infrastructure service making sale save, stock/batch deduction, PSE log and Rx status one transaction; US checkout path selected by Region.

nodes.label: PK Characterization (Golden) Tests
nodes.rationale: Mitigates PK regression risk: golden tests on PK receipt text and totals before refactoring; US behaviour only when RegionCode == US.

nodes.label: Two Pre-existing Failing Tests
nodes.rationale: ClearForm_ResetsAllProperties has a stale assertion (CostPrice now null); Preview_DoesNotLeakUnsavedSettingsIntoTheApp fails because the static Region cache is shared across parallel test classes and tests read the real region-settings.json.

nodes.label: Three Runtime Editions (Direct, StoreLite, StorePro)
nodes.rationale: One codebase: Direct (Inno Setup, yearly licence, all features) and MSIX Swifttill StoreLite/StorePro (subscription add-on).

nodes.label: EditionPolicy.IsInBuild Feature Gating
nodes.rationale: Pharmacy, CloudBackup and YearlyLicence are Direct-only: pharmacy is a vertical with regulatory questions, and cloud backup needs a service-account key that must not ship inside a public package. Changing it touches Store monetization and needs the owner decision (Hard Rule 7).

nodes.label: Proposed AppFeature.FrontStorePharmacy
nodes.rationale: US front-store pharmacy features gated on a new AppFeature (recommended Store Pro only), separate from the existing distributor Pharmacy feature which stays Direct-only.

nodes.label: Distributor Pharmacy vs US Front-Store Pharmacy Collision
nodes.rationale: Existing Pharmacy feature is a PK pharma-distribution workflow (B2B to pharmacies, doctors, medical reps, bonus units). PharmacyUser is a distributor-ops role, not a pharmacist; US features need distinct names (FrontStorePharmacy, Rx, WillCall).
nodes.norm_label: distributor pharmacy vs us front-store pharmacy collision

nodes.label: Database-Driven RBAC (23 permissions, seeded roles)
nodes.rationale: Permission constants seeded via HasData; runtime checks via SessionManager.HasPermission (HashSet). Seeded roles Admin, Manager, Cashier, PharmacyUser. Proposal: add Owner, Pharmacist, PharmacyTech additively.

nodes.label: Region Static Formatting Facade
nodes.rationale: Region in UI holds currency, number words, separators, date style; defaults reproduce Pakistan exactly. It lives in UI so Core/Infrastructure cannot use it, and its static mutable state causes flaky tests. Needs RegionCode (PK/US) and Culture.

nodes.label: Proposed IFormatService in Core
nodes.rationale: Pure, culture-parameterised service; Region becomes a facade over it so ~50 call sites and XAML x:Static keep working while PK output stays byte-identical.

nodes.label: Hard-Coded Money and Date Formats Bypassing Region
nodes.rationale: C# N0/N2 and XAML StringFormat ignore shop separator settings, and N0 drops cents ($3.49 prints as 3); fixed dd-MMM / day-first dates are ambiguous to US users.
nodes.norm_label: hard-coded money and date formats bypassing region

nodes.label: Settings Storage Split (JSON files vs DB)
nodes.rationale: region-settings.json, receipt-branding.json and per-user settings.json are outside cloud backups and lost on restore to a new PC; new business rules (tax config, PharmacyMode, PSE limits) should live in the DB so they travel with backups.
nodes.norm_label: settings storage split (json files vs db)

nodes.label: Firestore Whole-DB Cloud Backup and Restore
nodes.rationale: Native SQLite backup of the whole posapp.db, gzip, Base64, ~700 KB chunks in Firestore with sha256/chunkCount/schemaVersion metadata; keeps last 5 snapshots; restore verifies hash, refuses backups from a newer app, saves a .prerestore copy. Direct edition only.
nodes.norm_label: firestore whole-db cloud backup and restore

nodes.label: Additive Migrations Rule
nodes.rationale: Old cloud backups restore cleanly because Database.Migrate() upgrades the restored DB on next start, provided every new migration is additive and defaults existing rows. This is what keeps Hard Rule 3 (backup keeps working) true.

nodes.label: Pre-Migration DB Backup (Hard Rule 2)
nodes.rationale: No backup is taken before Migrate() today; proposal is a posapp.premigrate-<migration>.db copy when pending migrations exist.

nodes.label: EF Core Migrations on SQLite (WAL)
nodes.rationale: Applied by Database.Migrate() at startup; no model drift; DB at AppPaths.DatabasePath, relocatable with POSAPP_DATA_DIR.

nodes.label: Decimals Stored as TEXT in SQLite
nodes.rationale: SQLite has no decimal type so HasPrecision is cosmetic; SQL ORDER BY on money is text-based, so avoid SQL-side ordering of money.
nodes.norm_label: decimals stored as text in sqlite

nodes.label: Per-ViewModel Receipt Printing (no shared print service)
nodes.rationale: Each ViewModel builds its own FlowDocument/FixedDocument and calls PrintDialog.PrintDocument to the default printer without a dialog; UseSmallBillFormat switches 280 px (~80 mm) vs full page; 58 mm unsupported; no barcode/QR printed though ZXing is available.
nodes.norm_label: per-viewmodel receipt printing (no shared print service)

nodes.label: DirectPrintService Documented but Absent
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md mentions a DirectPrintService in Infrastructure but it does not exist.

nodes.label: No Sales Tax and Unrounded Discount Math
nodes.rationale: Only payroll IncomeTax exists. Line % or flat discounts plus two flat bill discounts; no rounding at all, so split discounts can store more than two decimals.
nodes.norm_label: no sales tax and unrounded discount math

nodes.label: Khata (customer owes) vs US Store Credit (shop owes) Ledgers
nodes.rationale: Two opposite semantics of credit; must be separate ledgers, never reuse Customer.CurrentBalance for both.
nodes.norm_label: khata (customer owes) vs us store credit (shop owes) ledgers

nodes.label: Sensitive Patient/PSE Data in Plain SQLite
nodes.rationale: No encryption at rest; realistic scope is access control and audit, worded as "designed to limit access".
nodes.norm_label: sensitive patient/pse data in plain sqlite

nodes.label: B1 Stale Sale Timestamp
nodes.rationale: SaleDate is set once at ViewModel construction and never reset by NewSale(), so every sale in a session gets the window-open time. Z reports, shift cash, tax-by-period and PSE windows depend on it; fix before Phase 1 reports.

nodes.label: B2 Duplicate Invoice Numbers
nodes.rationale: GetNextInvoiceNumberAsync parses the last row; a return ("R-...") makes it fall back to 11016; no unique index. Return-by-receipt-barcode could hit the wrong sale.

nodes.label: B3 Wrong Shift Expected Cash
nodes.rationale: Expected cash sums ReceiveCash (tendered, pre-change) across every payment type and ignores refunds; meaningless once card tenders exist; fixing changes the PK over/short number.

nodes.label: B4 Non-Atomic Sale Save
nodes.rationale: Sale insert, per-product updates and customer update use separate SaveChanges, so a crash can leave stock or khata inconsistent; FEFO/PSE/Rx must be in one transaction.

nodes.label: B5 SaleItem.Product Shadow FK Always Null
nodes.rationale: SaleItem.ProductId is a string but the Product key is int, so EF created shadow FK ProductId1 that is never set; category/product reports resolve as Uncategorized. Reports must join on the product code string.
nodes.norm_label: b5 saleitem.product shadow fk always null

nodes.label: B6 Stock Check and Quantity Rounding
nodes.rationale: Stock is int but decimal quantities are deducted with Math.Ceiling; out-of-stock is checked only on the barcode path.
nodes.norm_label: b6 stock check and quantity rounding

nodes.label: B7 Barcode Exact Match and Invalid Generated UPC-A
nodes.rationale: Lookup is an exact string match, Barcode is not unique, and generated yyMMddHHmmss codes look like UPC-A with an invalid check digit.
nodes.norm_label: b7 barcode exact match and invalid generated upc-a

nodes.label: B8 Missing Indexes and In-Memory Reports
nodes.rationale: No indexes on Sales.SaleDate, Sales.InvoiceNumber, Products.ProductId, SaleItems.ProductId; reports load full graphs into memory; target is 200k lines.
nodes.norm_label: b8 missing indexes and in-memory reports

nodes.label: Phase 3: Demo Data Seeder
nodes.rationale: DemoDataSeeder in Infrastructure writing to a separate data dir via POSAPP_DATA_DIR with a fixed seed; bypasses SyncLogInterceptor and uses bulk inserts; screenshots from an unpackaged Debug build.

nodes.label: Open Question Q1: Edition Placement of US Pharmacy Features
nodes.rationale: Options: Store Pro only (recommended), Store Lite and Pro, or Direct only. Cloud backup stays Direct-only, so Store users rely on local backups.
nodes.norm_label: open question q1: edition placement of us pharmacy features

nodes.label: Swifttill Microsoft Store Edition
nodes.rationale: One codebase ships as Direct (Inno Setup, Shah Jee POS) or Microsoft Store MSIX (Swifttill); detected by running from an MSIX package.

nodes.label: Direct vs Store Distribution Matrix
nodes.rationale: Direct: yearly renewal codes, all features incl. pharmacy and cloud backup, seeded logins. Store: Microsoft Store licensing, Lite (free) + Pro subscription, no pharmacy/cloud backup, first-run wizard creates the owner.

nodes.label: Swifttill Pro Subscription Add-ons
nodes.rationale: Subscription add-ons pro_monthly / pro_yearly; any Product ID starting with pro_ unlocks Pro (EditionService.ProProductIdPrefix). Pro unlocks wholesale, purchases and suppliers, expenses, Excel export, >2 users, custom roles, HR. A lapsed subscription drops back to Lite without touching data.

nodes.label: POSAPP_DATA_DIR Data Directory Override
nodes.rationale: Env var relocates database/logs/settings so tests, demos and Store-behaviour tries never touch real data.

nodes.label: POSAPP_EDITION Edition Override (Debug builds only)
nodes.rationale: Values lite/pro/direct simulate Store editions without packaging; in Debug + lite the upgrade dialog shows sample plans and Subscribe simulates a purchase.

nodes.label: Partner Center Submission Process
nodes.rationale: Reserve name, copy identity into store-identity.json, create subscription add-ons, build MSIX, run certification kit, upload the unsigned msix (the Store signs it) with screenshots, description, age rating and privacy policy URL.

nodes.label: packaging/store-identity.json
nodes.rationale: Holds Package/Identity/Name, Publisher CN and PublisherDisplayName copied from Partner Center product identity.

nodes.label: build-msix.ps1 / Build-MSIX.cmd
nodes.rationale: Builds dist/Swifttill-<version>.msix; every submission needs a higher version; -Sign and -Install support local test installs; refuses to package firebase-credentials.json.

nodes.label: Privacy Policy URL Requirement
nodes.rationale: Required because the app stores customer names and phone numbers; the Store edition sends nothing anywhere (no cloud backup) and the policy should say so.

nodes.label: runFullTrust Restricted Capability Justification
nodes.rationale: A full-trust desktop app must explain it needs direct thermal-printer access and a local SQLite database.

nodes.label: Data Location via AppPaths (MSIX redirect)
nodes.rationale: Database and logs in %LocalAppData%\ShahJeePOS, redirected into package private storage under MSIX; a legacy posapp.db beside the exe is copied (not moved) on first start.

nodes.label: Partner Center Asset Checklist
nodes.rationale: Maps each Partner Center field (poster 2:3, box art 1:1, tile icons, super hero 16:9, screenshots, trailer) to a file and PASS status; the brief calls 1440x2160 "9:16" but it is 2:3, which matches Partner Center spec.

nodes.label: SwiftTill Mark (flat cash-register logo)
nodes.rationale: Vector redraw of the existing app-icon.png (src/logo.svg) plus a simplified <=71px variant (src/logo-simple.svg); no new logo was invented.

nodes.label: SwiftTill Brand Palette (navy background, green accent)
nodes.rationale: Palette and fonts kept in src/brand.json; artwork uses navy gradient #23314D to #141D2E with green #4DBB72 accent and Segoe UI Variable.
nodes.norm_label: swifttill brand palette (navy background, green accent)

nodes.label: render.py HTML/SVG to PNG Rendering Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Pages rendered by Edge headless at device scale 1; tiles under 600 px rendered at 1200 px and downscaled with Pillow because Edge has a ~500 px minimum window width.
nodes.norm_label: render.py html/svg to png rendering pipeline

nodes.label: Demo Mart Demo Dataset
nodes.rationale: 40 generic products with GS1 in-store barcode prefix 200 (never a real brand), 10 fictional customers with placeholder phones, 3 suppliers with .example emails, 2 users, 369 sales over 21 days.

nodes.label: DemoSeed Project (seed/DemoSeed)
nodes.rationale: Builds seed/demo.sqlite using the app's own EF migrations in a temp folder so the demo DB matches the real schema.

nodes.label: Seven Real-App Desktop Screenshots
nodes.rationale: Billing, receipt preview, inventory overview, sales report, khata customers, users, local backup; taken as Store Pro on demo data, un-retouched, plus an optional framed 2560x1440 set.

nodes.label: Windows UI Automation Screenshot Capture
nodes.rationale: Capture-Screenshots.ps1 drives the real app via built-in Windows UI Automation (nothing installed) and sizes each window frame to exactly 1920x1080 before a screen grab.

nodes.label: verify.ps1 Asset Verification
nodes.rationale: Checks dimensions and file-size limits of every asset: 24 checked, 24 passed, trailer 3.02 MB.

nodes.label: Store Feature Audit (claims vs Store build)
nodes.rationale: Certification checks that listing claims match the app. Pharmacies, cloud backup, custom invoice templates and stock reports are not in the Store build and must be removed or reworded.
nodes.norm_label: store feature audit (claims vs store build)

nodes.label: SwiftTill vs Swifttill Name Casing Inconsistency
nodes.rationale: Artwork says SwiftTill (per brief); the app UI says Swifttill; the Partner Center reservation is swifttill. One spelling must be chosen and artwork regenerated via render.py.
nodes.norm_label: swifttill vs swifttill name casing inconsistency

nodes.label: Product Issues Found During Asset Work
nodes.rationale: Not fixed (out of scope): PharmacyUser role shown in Store build, backup default path under Documents exposes the Windows account name, Khata Today filter stays highlighted after clicking All.
nodes.norm_label: product issues found during asset work

nodes.label: PharmacyUser Role Visible in Store Build
nodes.rationale: Role is seeded and shown on the Roles screen though pharmacy screens do not exist in the Store build.
nodes.norm_label: pharmacyuser role visible in store build

nodes.label: Skipped Assets (Xbox art, cloud-backup shot, printed receipt)
nodes.rationale: Cloud backup screenshot replaced with local Backup and Restore because cloud backup is not in the Store build and showing it would misrepresent the product; Xbox art skipped as not an Xbox product; real printed receipt skipped because only Microsoft Print to PDF was available.
nodes.norm_label: skipped assets (xbox art, cloud-backup shot, printed receipt)

nodes.label: Store Product Features (12 bullets)
nodes.rationale: Each bullet <=60 chars and backed by named code: barcode billing, shortcuts, 80mm/A4 printing, receipt branding, products/categories, low-stock alerts, khata ledger, sales reports, returns and shifts, local backup, offline, Pro extras.

nodes.label: Store Search Keywords (7)
nodes.rationale: Seven keywords totalling 14 words against a 21-word cap.

nodes.label: Listing Claims vs Code Audit
nodes.rationale: Every product-summary claim is checked against code and whether it exists in the Store build via EditionPolicy.IsInBuild; no unsupported claim appears in bullets or keywords.

nodes.label: Claim: For Pharmacies (not in Store build)
nodes.rationale: PharmacySaleWindow, PharmacyManagementWindow and DoctorManagementWindow exist but EditionPolicy.IsInBuild(Pharmacy) is Direct-only, so remove from listing.
nodes.norm_label: claim: for pharmacies (not in store build)

nodes.label: Claim: Cloud Backup/Restore (not in Store build)
nodes.rationale: CloudBackupService is Direct-only because the Firebase key cannot ship inside an MSIX; say "local backup and restore" instead.
nodes.norm_label: claim: cloud backup/restore (not in store build)

nodes.label: Claim: Custom Invoice Templates (missing)
nodes.rationale: Only receipt header/footer text and 80mm/A4 layout exist; reword to "your shop name and message on receipts".

nodes.label: Claim: Stock Reports (missing)

nodes.label: Screenshot Re-run Procedure
nodes.rationale: Rebuild demo.sqlite with dates relative to today, run Capture-Screenshots.ps1, optionally frame.py, then verify.ps1; do not touch mouse or keyboard while it runs.

nodes.label: Trailer Re-record Procedure
nodes.rationale: Install imageio-ffmpeg locally, reseed, run Record-Trailer.ps1 then trailer.py; captions, speeds and trims live in SCENES in trailer.py.

nodes.label: Demo DB Isolation via Process-Scoped Env Vars
nodes.rationale: Start-DemoApp.ps1 sets POSAPP_DATA_DIR and POSAPP_EDITION only for the launched process (no app file edited) and refuses to run if the runtime folder resolves to the real %LocalAppData%\ShahJeePOS.
nodes.norm_label: demo db isolation via process-scoped env vars

nodes.label: 125% Display Scaling Caveat
nodes.rationale: Capture machine was at 125% so windows are sized to exactly 1920x1080 physical pixels, but UI is drawn 25% larger; set 100% and re-run for the intended look.

nodes.label: Per-Screen Manual Capture Fallback
nodes.rationale: Step lists for each of the seven screens (barcodes to scan, tabs to open) if automation breaks after a UI change.
